title: Simple Ground Removal (height threshold + grid min-z)
hints: Height threshold: in the sensor frame the ground is at z ≈ −sensor_height. A point is ground iff z < −sensor_height + threshold.
Grid version, pass 1: cell = (floor(x/cell), floor(y/cell)), and keep the min z per cell in an unordered_map (or std::map) keyed by the pair.
Pass 2: a point is ground iff z − minZ[its cell] < threshold. Collect the non-ground indices in input order.
